flavours.name: Indian
flavours.base: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the chopped onion for 8 minutes, until soft and golden. Add the cumin seeds, then the crushed garlic and grated ginger, and stir for a minute. Stir in the turmeric, garam masala and chilli powder for 30 seconds.

flavours.name: Mexican
flavours.base: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the chopped onion for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft. Add the crushed garlic, cumin, paprika, chilli powder and oregano and stir for a minute.

flavours.name: Italian
flavours.base: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the chopped onion for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft, then add the crushed garlic and oregano and stir for a minute.
flavours.finish: Tear in the basil and season with black pepper.

flavours.name: Mediterranean
flavours.base: Heat the oil in a large pan, add the crushed garlic and oregano and stir for 30 seconds.
flavours.finish: Stir in the lemon juice and season with black pepper.

flavours.name: Chinese-style
flavours.base: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat, add the crushed garlic and grated ginger and stir for 30 seconds.
flavours.finish: Stir in the soy sauce and scatter over the sliced spring onions.

templates.name: {flavour} {protein} rice bowl
method: {prep}
Cook the {carb} as the packet says.
{flavour_base}
Add the {protein} and cook, stirring now and then, until {done}.
Add the {veg} with a splash of water and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, until just tender.
{flavour_finish}
Divide between containers. Cool quickly (within an hour, as cooked rice left out can make you ill) and keep in the fridge for up to {fridge_days} days. Reheat until piping hot all the way through.

templates.name: {flavour} {protein} and {carb} traybake
method: {prep}
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan, gas 6).
Toss the {carb} with half the oil and the herbs and spices (chop any onion and crush any garlic first), spread over a large roasting tin and roast for 20 minutes.
Add the {protein} with the {veg}, toss everything with the rest of the oil and roast for 15 to 20 minutes more, until everything is tender and {done}.
